sites.protectedScope: 56 exact existing snapshots; all changed/new pages in runtime inventory

rules: No mass noindex due to quality audit
New content: topical substance plus cited claims plus review plus multi-page duplication checks
Each CMS/platform needs a real adapter, a publishing hook and deployment evidence
Do not call overall fleet PASS until every actual target has a source and public prepublish proof
